name: top
description: top(1) shows the kernel's per-process CPU time and load average.  A staged script starts a CPU-bound copy of yes under the name spinme, waits eight seconds, runs top -s 2 and quits it with an injected q after about 22 seconds.  top_check.py reads top's last frame: the 1-minute load average is not 0.00, spinme's TIME is at least one second and its DTIME is not 0.00.  Each is 0 without its kernel half (the heartbeat's tick charging, procs(2)'s utime/stime, _Vm_Loadav).
